listing.name: Street Fighter Alpha 3 (Dreamcast) — Street-Alpha-3-Dreamcast-Recomp (irnutsmurt)
listing.summary: Native fighting runtime/online and controls described; exact all-character/mode/full-playthrough acceptance not established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA NTSC-U Dreamcast release as GDI with tracks 01/02/03, Redump CUE/BIN or CHD. Setup checks the SHA-1 of 1ST_READ.BIN; this guide does not include the expected value.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README declares setup bundles extracting owned disc, validating program, translating main+111 character overlays and compiling locally. Native setup app creates player shortcuts/VMU data.

warnings: Native fighting runtime/online and controls described; exact all-character/mode/full-playthrough acceptance not established.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
